title: My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked TV Anime Reveals 3 More Cast Members
content: NBC Universal revealed three new cast members for the television anime of Otsuji 's My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked ( Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi ) manga on Monday. The new characters will appear in the anime's ninth episode on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Sony Music Entertainment Japan, GungHo Online Entertainment Form Capital, Business Alliance
content: GungHo Online Entertainment announced on Friday that it is entering into a capital and business alliance with Sony Music Entertainment Japan (SME). SME will acquire shares of GungHo in an off-market bilateral transaction for the total offering price of 28,635,502,500 yen (about US$179,347,387).
author: ANN

title: Webtoon Ent. Reports US$15.6 Million Operating Loss in 2nd Quarter of 2026
content: WEBTOON Entertainment Inc. reported an operating loss of US$15.6 million for the second quarter of 2026, widening from an operating loss of US$8.8 million in the same period last year. The company disclosed the results on August 10. Quarterly revenue came in at US$338.5 million, down 2.8% year-over-year.
author: ANN

content: Fantasy anime series have always been at the top of the industry as they explore unique worlds, characters, power systems, and captivating plots. The genre is broad, as every series includes a supernatural theme and setting.

title: 'FX Senshi Kurumi-chan' Unveils Additional Staff, Opening Theme, Main Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Demunyan and Daisuki Tansan 's FX Senshi Kurumi-chan ( FX Fighter Kurumi-chan ) manga unveiled additional staff, the opening theme, and the main promotional video on Monday. The anime will premiere on October 1 at 9.30 p.m.

title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan TV Anime Reveals October 1 Debut in Main Promo Video
content: Kadokawa revealed the main promotional video on Monday for the television anime of storywriter Demunyan and artist Daisuki Tansan 's FX Fighter Kurumi-chan ( FX Senshi Kurumi-chan ) manga. The company also revealed the anime will debut on October 1.

title: Music Ray'n Suspends Activities of Voice Actress Moka Hinata, States She 'Engaged in Conduct That Damaged Trust'
content: Talent agency Music Ray'n announced on Monday that it has suspended all activities of voice actress Moka Hinata until the end of December 2026, after it has confirmed that Hinata has engaged in conduct that has "severely damaged trust" with the parties involved.
author: ANN
